text: The mission sets a clear, measurable target of reducing drought impacts by 30% by 2030. It employs a systems approach integrating on-farm technology, regional water security, and policy/data enablers. Key components include the Climate Services for Agriculture program, a national drought map, soil loss and wind erosion risk tools, and water banking technologies. The mission also emphasizes Indigenous knowledge integration and has a governance model that fosters scalability through 'crowd-in' co-investment mechanisms.
